summary: A phased interior renewal that keeps the public entrance accessible and gives the community a flexible, durable gathering space.

scope.text: Renovate the 3,200-square-foot assembly room: partitions, acoustic finishes and accessible interior doors.
Protect the occupied entrance and separate public access from construction activities.

approach.text: Confirm existing conditions before ordering finish materials.
Sequence demolition, rough-in and finishes behind a temporary separation; coordinate noisy work with the owner.

team.text: Morgan Lee — proposed project manager. Availability requires confirmation.
Site superintendent — nomination pending; no individual or credentials have been supplied.

schedule.text: Owner target: 12 weeks after written notice to proceed. This is a target, not a committed completion date.
Notice to proceed, permit timing and long-lead approvals remain unresolved.

exclusions.text: Base includes the three priced scope lines below. Sales tax treatment and permit fees require confirmation; no additional amounts have been assumed.
Hazardous material abatement and concealed structural repairs are excluded from the supplied pricing.

questions.text: Confirm site access windows, permit responsibility and the tax basis before acceptance.
Confirm the proposed project manager and appoint the site superintendent.
Decide whether to accept the acoustic upgrade option; it is excluded from the base total.
